input_model.source: committed UTF-8 Cargo.toml blobs already authorized by R3
input_model.normalization: Unicode NFC plus slash-separated repository-relative path normalization
input_model.unknown_key_policy: fail closed unless the family or field has an exact typed unsupported mapping

package_metadata.publish_field: false or a bounded registry-name array
package_metadata.inheritance_semantics: emit a workspace_reference value and REFERENCES_DECLARATION edge without copying or claiming an effective Cargo value
package_metadata.file_selection_semantics: include and exclude are declarations only and emit cargo.package_file_selection_not_applied

target_declarations.required_features_semantics: preserve names and byte evidence without checking or activating them
target_declarations.proc_macro_semantics: preserve the declaration and emit cargo.proc_macro_not_executed when true
target_declarations.autodiscovery_semantics: record literal auto* declarations; fail unsupported_structural_interaction if they contradict the accepted R3 source-root plan

source_classification: workspace=true selects workspace_inherited and forbids locator or package override fields
git selects git and may carry exactly one of branch tag or rev
path selects path and is normalized against the declaring package root without opening it
otherwise a version string selects registry_default
dependencies.compatible_version_hint: version may accompany path or git as a declaration but is never validated against source content
dependencies.target_predicate_semantics: preserve the normalized literal predicate as identity evidence without cfg evaluation
dependencies.workspace_inheritance_semantics: link the member declaration to the exact root workspace dependency by declared name without materializing an effective dependency
dependencies.requested_features_semantics: preserve names and byte evidence without activation
dependencies.optional_semantics: preserve the literal flag without inventing an implicit feature

features.bare_member_semantics: do not decide whether a bare member names a local feature or an implicit optional dependency
features.default_feature_semantics: default is an ordinary declared feature and is never treated as active

patches.source_locator_semantics: emit only SHA-256 plus source evidence
patches.application_semantics: applied is always false and cargo.patch_not_applied is required

build_scripts.path_semantics: normalize a literal path inside the repository without execution
build_scripts.presence_semantics: committed_present is an immutable inventory fact

external_locators.identity_input: only a patch source-selector digest; dependency and package locator values never enter entity identity

ordering.manifest_index: manifest path by unsigned NFC UTF-8 bytes
ordering.targets: manifest path then target-kind rank then target name then normalized source path
ordering.dependencies: manifest path then scope then target predicate then dependency-kind rank then declared name
ordering.features: manifest path then feature name; members by syntax then lexeme
ordering.patches: manifest path then selector kind then selector identity then declared name

semantic_non_claims: fetched registry Git or path content
executed build script procedural macro or target
